vetSays.line: A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
📋 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.

🌱 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
